name: Container Image Design, Hardening & Operations
purpose: Build small, reproducible container images with multi-stage builds, pinned digests, non-root execution, explicit health checks, minimal attack surface, and verified SBOM provenance.
inputs: Base image policy: approved minimal images with digests plus the CVE ceiling
Application runtime needs: ports, read/write paths, syscalls, shutdown grace period
Registry and signing setup: registry URL, cosign identity, SBOM tool version
Resource envelope: memory, CPU, and ephemeral storage limits
outputs: Multi-stage Dockerfile with pinned digests, non-root user, and real health check
Build, scan, and sign steps producing SBOM and signature
Image report: final size, layer count, CVE count by severity, digest
stop_conditions: Image builds reproducibly with matching digests and passes health and shutdown checks
Security scan shows zero HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs with SBOM generated and signature attached
Image size within budget and layer count justified
